en.p: For a real number $t$, let $f(t)$ be the $x$-coordinate of the point where the two curves $y=t-\log_2 x$ and $y=2^{x-t}$ meet.
For each statement in <Statements>, the values of $A$, $B$, $C$ are determined by the following rules. Find the value of $A+B+C$. (Here $A+B+C\ne 0$.) [4 points]

box: • If statement a. is true, $A=100$; if false, $A=0$.
• If statement b. is true, $B=10$; if false, $B=0$.
• If statement c. is true, $C=1$; if false, $C=0$.
b. As the value of the real number $t$ increases, the value of $f(t)$ also increases.
c. For every positive real number $t$, $f(t)\ge t$.
